problems: The hat tilts away from the camera: k.turn(-10, ...) tips the crown top toward +y, so the flat top shows only as a thin sliver and the brim looks like it is seen from below. Tilt it toward the camera instead, with a positive x turn.
The silk renders almost white, so it does not read as grey silk. Use a darker grey.
The brim curl is too strong. The left side rises into a large scoop and the right side flattens into a thin blade, so the brim looks lopsided. Make the curl milder.
The bow sits at x = -0.29, on the side facing away from the camera at azimuth 30, so it cannot be seen and only a lump shows. Move it to the side the camera sees.

The brim reads as a lopsided teardrop. The right side comes to a pinched point and the left side looks flat or turned down, so you can't see the 'curled brim' the card asks for as a matching roll on both sides.
The curl is too weak (1.3*sx² lifts the edge only about 0.06 to 0.09), and the -6° roll in k.turn hides it on one side while making it look pointed on the other.
The brim oval is the wrong way round. Scaling y by 0.92 makes it longest from side to side, but a top hat's brim and head opening are longest from front to back and narrower at the curled sides.
